The Articles of Association authorise acceptance of calls in advance; option 3. Stray st in option 4 is an OCR defect.
Backward trace from Balance Sheet reverses Trading -> P&L -> P&L Appropriation; A,B,C, option 1.
A-III, B-I, C-IV, D-II; option 2. Definitions belong to share capital.
Profit and salary go to Current Account; additional capital and agreed permanent capital withdrawal to Capital Account: I-B, II-A, III-B, IV-A, option 2.
Interest and profit credit current; drawings debit current; additional capital credits capital: A-II B-III C-I D-II, option 1.

Intended paid capital per share = 10 - 3 = 7, premium excluded; 4,200/7 = 600, option 2. Stem should explicitly say all other capital instalments were paid; otherwise received share capital is not fully specified.
A-II B-IV C-I D-III, option 4. Reserve capital is uncalled capital reserved for winding up. Share Capital mapping.
